status: frozen before any Granite Vision 4.1 benchmark result, weight download completion, or AttnRes adaptation launch
purpose: Replace the stopped Granite Vision 3.3 preflight with one current-generation architecture-transfer test. The replacement preserves native dynamic-resolution processing and uses one fixed recipe with a seed-0 promotion gate.

model_selection.reason: Current Apache-2.0 IBM VLM with a 40-layer Granite text decoder, a model-native dynamic-resolution processor, and an architecture distinct from the Qwen primary models.

preflight_evidence_before_freeze.processor: unmodified Granite Vision 4.1 native dynamic-resolution processor
preflight_evidence_before_freeze.sequence_policy: Use max_sequence_length=2048 without changing image_grid_pinpoints, tile selection, or processor output. Reject overlength examples in the same deterministic stream policy used by the existing trainer.
preflight_evidence_before_freeze.stopped_granite_3p3_preflight: Granite Vision 3.3 commonly produced 6k-plus native sequences under the frozen 1536-token setup; it was stopped before a benchmark result or checkpoint rather than simplified to one tile.

fixed_recipe.adapter_parameter_budget_rationale: Ten rank-144 adapters contain 7,372,800 weights, matching the 7,372,800 adapter weights used by the six-block rank-300 SmolVLM2 experiment.

evaluation.processor_policy: same native processor, trust_remote_code=true, and fix_mistral_regex=true for Base, Full AttnRes, and Full RSM-AttnRes

run_seeds_1_and_2_only_if: seed-0 RSM exceeds seed-0 matched Full AttnRes by at least 0.15 percentage points
three_seed_acceptance: mean paired RSM-minus-Full gain is at least 0.15 percentage points
mean RSM macro exceeds Frozen Base
at least two of three paired seed deltas are positive
promotion_gate.failure_policy: Report Granite Vision 4.1 as a failed current-model transfer and stop recipe/model search for this extension.

material_passport.evaluation_data: local lmms-eval caches for the six formal VLM tasks
material_passport.hardware: node42 GPUs 2, 3, and 6 for seed-0; GPU 7 excluded
